title: dots-superkit/mail-v1
description: One append-only line in mail/<agentId>/in.jsonl (main session to agent) or mail/<agentId>/out.jsonl (agent to main session) in the shared folder on `local`. This is the shape only. Who may write which file, the event rules each kind maps to and the reading cadence are in workflows/direct-mail.md. Exactly these ten fields, all required, no extras.

id.description: Opaque, unique message id, for example m-20261123T001500Z-4f2a. Not an ordering.

t.description: RFC 3339 UTC time of the append.

task.description: The approved task, the same value as the agent's live records.

kind.description: Main session to agent: task, question, answer, review, note. Agent to main session: ack, answer, question, result, block, note.

re.description: Id of the message this line answers. Non-null on every line that answers one: an ack, answer or note always, and a result, question or block too. Null only on a first result, question or block that answers no mail line, and then refs names what it is about.

text.description: Plain text. No secrets, credentials, tokens, personal identifiers or raw logs.

refs.description: Exact references: rev/* branch, full commit SHA, local:<workspace path>, path, link, gate:<ID>, or supersedes:<message id>.
